name: malakim_warrior
description: a Malakim Warrior (Fall from Heaven), a bare-chested desert warrior: brown skin and a short black beard, a cream turban with a teal band and a gold-set teal jewel at the front, a cream sash across the chest, a white kilt with a hanging teal sash and a gold buckle, gold and teal armbands, brown leather boots, a studded wooden club with round knobs in his RIGHT hand, and a round cream shield with a teal rim, gold studs and a gold boss on his LEFT arm
hands: the studded club stays in his right hand on the screen-left side and the round shield stays on his left arm on the screen-right side

strike.1: anticipation: weight shifts back onto the rear leg, torso leans back toward the upper-left, the studded club is lifted beside the head with its knobbed head pointing up and back
strike.2: wind-up extreme: body coiled back and crouched, the club hand behind the head and the studded club hanging down behind the shoulders to the left, the round shield tucked across the belly
strike.3: swing: the front foot steps toward the lower-right, the torso whips round, the club arm sweeps across in front of the chest and the studded club is level, its knobbed head pointing to the right
strike.4: contact: club arm fully extended toward the lower-right, the knobbed head of the studded club smashing down-right, front knee bent, body low and leaning in, the round shield arm swung back behind the shoulders for balance
strike.5: follow-through: the studded club carries on down until its knobbed head nearly touches the ground at the lower-right, torso twisted, the teal sash trailing back
strike.6: recover: body rises, front foot pulls back halfway, the studded club comes back up on the near side toward the ready angle, the round shield tucked across the belly

flinch.0: impact: hit from the lower-right; head snaps back toward the upper-left, eyes squeezed shut, torso jolts back, both arms jerk outward (club arm thrown up and out to the left, the round shield flung out to the right)
flinch.1: recoil extreme: leaning back further toward the upper-left, knees bent, the studded club dipping, the round shield still held out

death.1: stagger back: a step back toward the upper-left, body thrown back, club arm flung up, the round shield drooping
death.2: knees buckle: hips drop, knees fold forward, torso slumps forward, turbaned head droops, the studded club lowering
death.3: kneeling: on both knees, slumped forward, the club's knobbed head resting on the ground at the lower-right, shield arm hanging
death.4: falling back: torso tips back toward the upper-left, the studded club slips out of the hand, legs slide forward
death.5: hits the ground: lying on his back along the ground, feet toward the lower-right and head toward the upper-left, the turban still on his head; the studded club lies on the ground at the lower-right; the round shield lies flat beside him
death.6: bounce: head and shoulders lift slightly off the ground, the round shield rocks
death.7: corpse: lying flat and still on his back, eyes closed, the studded club and the round shield on the ground beside him
